video.title: AI欧腐《夏洛克与华生：理性之外/Sherlock and Watson: Closer Than Logic》
video.desc:
In a dark, Victorian London, a tormented army surgeon is forced into the service of a brilliant but damaged detective. Together, they navigate a dangerous criminal underworld where every secret comes at a deadly price.
在阴暗的维多利亚时代伦敦，一位饱受折磨的军医被迫为一名天才却满身伤痕的侦探效力。
他们一同深入危机四伏的犯罪暗网，在那里，每一个秘密都要以生命作为代价。
